name: Sinusoidal Temporal Encoding
definition: A method to represent a scalar input timestamp t with high precision by expanding it into a high-dimensional vector γ(t) using sinusoidal functions, which is then processed by a shallow neural module (TimeMLP) to yield a high-level temporal feature ftime.
summary: Sinusoidal Temporal Encoding expands timestamps into high-dimensional vectors using fixed-frequency sinusoidal bases, distinguishing itself from learned methods by relying on static frequency mappings processed by a dedicated TimeMLP.
